# KUCH — Marketing Agency

## English

KUCH is a full-cycle marketing agency based in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.
Slogan: "WE ARE NOT AFRAID OF COMPLEXITY" (МЫ НЕ БОИМСЯ СЛОЖНОГО).
Core values: Strength · Hard Work · Results.
Voice: Direct · Confident · No fluff · To the point.

### Services
- Marketing Strategy (/services/marketing-strategy) — Market research, positioning, KPI roadmap. From $3,000/project.
- Brand Strategy (/services/brand-strategy) — Brand platform, archetype, voice, promise. From $4,000/project.
- Communication Strategy (/services/communication-strategy) — Key messages, tone of voice, content strategy. From $2,500/project.
- Ad Campaign (/services/ad-campaign) — Creative concept through media buying and analytics. From $5,000/project.
- Outsource Marketing (/services/outsource-marketing) — Full marketing department as a service. From $1,500/month.
- Branding (/services/branding) — Logo, visual identity, brand book. From $6,000/project.

### Site Sections
- Homepage (/) — Landing page with hero, about, team, services, pricing, cases, blog, rating, talks, contact.
- Services (/services) — Overview of all 6 agency services.
- Pricing (/pricing) — USD price ranges for each service.
- Cases (/cases) — Portfolio: KUCH × Wellco, KUCH × GRAVITY, and more.
- Blog (/blog) — Articles on marketing, branding, and strategy.
- Rating (/rating) — Agency performance metrics and market positioning.
- Kuch Talks (/kuch-talks) — Video interviews and conversations with industry experts.
- Brief (/brief) — Online project brief form (multi-step).
- Contact (/contact) — Contact information and lead form.

Столпы: Сила · Тяжёлая работа · Результат.
Голос: Прямо · Уверенно · Без воды · По делу.

- Бренд-стратегия (/services/brand-strategy) — от $4 000 / проект
- Коммуникационная стратегия (/services/communication-strategy) — от $2 500 / проект
- Рекламная кампания (/services/ad-campaign) — от $5 000 / проект
- Аутсорс-маркетинг (/services/outsource-marketing) — от $1 500 / месяц
- Брендинг (/services/branding) — от $6 000 / проект

### Разделы сайта
- Главная (/) — Лендинг: о нас, команда, услуги, прайс, кейсы, блог, рейтинг, kuch talks, контакты.
- Услуги (/services) — Все 6 услуг агентства.
- Прайс (/pricing) — Ценовые диапазоны в USD.
- Кейсы (/cases) — Портфолио проектов.
- Блог (/blog) — Статьи о маркетинге, брендинге и стратегии.
- Рейтинг (/rating) — Позиции агентства в отраслевых рейтингах.
- Kuch Talks (/kuch-talks) — Видео-интервью с экспертами.
- Онлайн Бриф (/brief) — Форма для заявки на проект.
- Контакт (/contact) — Контактная информация и форма обратной связи.
